question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

The poet managed to paint a __vivid__ picture of the landscape by the river through words.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Evocative**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the underlined word 'Vivid' is 'Evocative'.
 
• **Vivid **(जीवंत) - producing powerful mental images or clear, intense impressions in the mind.
 
 
• Example: The writer used vivid descriptions to transport the reader to a different time and place.
 
 
 
• **Evocative **(उत्प्रेरक) - bringing strong memories, images or feelings to mind.
 
 
• Example: The evocative scent of the ocean reminded him of childhood summer vacations. 
 
 

​Correct Answer: **Evocative**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Contemporary **(समकालीन) - relating to the present time or modern day.
 
• **Blurred **(धुंधला) - not clear or sharply defined.
 
• **Metaphoric **(लाक्षणिक) - using metaphorical language to describe something, meaning something other than its literal definition.
